modules.name: Portfolio routes and metadata
modules.description: Next.js App Router pages, route metadata, sitemap, robots directives, and server-side case-study rendering.

modules.name: Canonical portfolio content
modules.description: Canonical profile, personal context, resume, project taxonomy, claims, and page copy.

public_api.name: getProjectBySlug
public_api.description: Finds a published project case study.

modules.name: Personal context and community surfaces
modules.description: Small, source-backed personal interests, community teaching, hobby-podcast, and life-lately surfaces that keep the portfolio human without exposing private detail.

public_api.name: /community
public_api.description: Community teaching, mentoring, and podcast context.

modules.name: Portfolio interface components
modules.description: Accessible header, filters, home sections, project cards, and shared UI.

modules.name: Contact and resume proxy routes
modules.description: Turnstile-protected contact delivery and restricted resume PDF proxy.

public_api.name: contact
public_api.description: Validates and delivers a contact message.
public_api.inputs: contact form JSON plus Turnstile token

public_api.name: resumePdf
public_api.description: Downloads a declared resume PDF from the backend API.

modules.name: Principal-design controls
modules.description: Route inventory, measurable visual thresholds, accessible motion requirements, and reviewer-owned evidence capture for the portfolio.

public_api.name: check:design
public_api.description: Validates design tokens, documented criteria, and route inventory.

public_api.name: test:visual:evidence
public_api.description: Captures reviewable non-baseline screenshots at approved viewports.

modules.name: Browser-native Makerspace presentation viewers
modules.description: Static in-browser slide decks for community presentations. Each deck uses normal in-site navigation and renders source-slide images with keyboard, button, range, and participant-facing per-slide documentation, context, and practice prompts instead of asking visitors to download documents.

public_api.name: /community/presentations/[slug]
public_api.description: Renders a browser-native Makerspace slide deck.

modules.name: Remote leadership positioning
modules.description: A single governed source for remote-only leadership availability, target roles, résumé-sourced proof points, public recruiter path, and a profile-owner LinkedIn alignment checklist.

public_api.name: remote leadership focus
public_api.description: Supplies the current role focus and verified proof-point identifiers to public portfolio routes.

public_api.name: check:design
public_api.description: Prevents public positioning from reintroducing Austin or omitting the governed remote role focus.

known_limitations: Resume PDFs are served by a separate backend and require an environment-specific API URL.
Contact delivery depends on configured Turnstile and Postmark credentials.
